description: If Peru’s on your list and you’re stuck on how to plan it out, this is the 10-day route we followed and it flowed really well. Save this for later — more Peru tips coming. In order:  Lima (Miraflores + Barranco + food) → sea lions (Palomino/Callao) → fly to Cusco + acclimate → Cusco city/ruins → Sacred Valley (Chinchero/Moray/Maras/Pisac) → Ollantaytambo → Aguas Calientes → Machu Picchu (Circuit 2A) → Rainbow Mountain (+ Red Valley if clear) → back to Lima → Paracas + Huacachina → surf + Barranco to end it. #Peru #MachuPicchu #cuscoperu #LimaPeru #PeruTravel
